title: Copper nanocluster-mediated degradation of toxic organic dyes: a sustainable approach to water remediation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,464-473
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08780E, Paper

Aarya, Kavya P., Chanchal N. S., Devika V., Athira Sathyan, Supratik Sen Mojumdar
Toxic organic dyes released by industries persist in the environment and pose serious hazards. Here, rapid and complete degradation of RhB and MB is achieved through a simple protocol based on the synergistic action of Cys-Cu NCs and H2O2.
